notes.title: All Beta Components Now In Campaign Mode
notes.content:
[h1]First Of All, Thank You For Playing The Game[/h1]
At first, we do not expect many players to win the game because the map designs are insanely difficult. However, how wrong we were to think so, up to 6.2% of players passed the final bomb in chapter "Nuclear CORE", that's an amazing result, this proves that players really spend time and dedication to analyze and defuse those bombs we made. Not only defuse it, players even try to speedrun it with minimal action counts, and finish the bomb within a few seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/3587adc1788233f45336fecba2c32d5cc60e17dd.png[/img]

[h1]We Have Made 10 More Campaign Bombs For Our Newest Components[/h1]
Those 4 new components are:
[list]
[*] Persistent Battery
[*] NAND Logic Gate
[*] Switch Logic Gate
[*] Intersect Gate
[/list]
These campaign bombs will be available after you complete chapter 9 "Nuclear CORE" as a bonus level, these designs are not difficult, still, it changes drastically your bomb-defusing mindset with their abilities.
We thank you for submitting your ideas, concepts, bugs, etc. So we can see the problems we're missing and what can we do to expand our game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/e92e415c389cdd304698cddf21c4352be2c53161.png[/img]

[h1]The best designer? It's you[/h1]
Creative, mind-blowing, etc. There’s no such word that can describe the bomb designs made by players around the globe, Not just hards, these designs carry unique play styles, making the game even more fun. Thanks for your time and dedication, we hope to see more in the future
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/9ee814894540c88320381885e60edba04ddafe60.png[/img]

tags.feature: We Have Made 10 More Campaign Bombs For Our Newest Components

notes.title: The Fastest Hand Event
notes.content:
[h1]Fun Summer & Explosive Bombs[/h1]
From Yenthe Studio, we'd all like to thank you for playing our game and wish you have a great time trying to beat us (although we left hints in the main menu in case you might need them ( ͡~ ͜ʖ ͡°) 

This month's event features the new global leaderboard system, by verifying your account, you're guaranteed to participate in the event and try your best to get the 100$ reward for the top 1 in the leaderboard. (There also TOP 2 & TOP3, just try your best :3 )

[h1]Where can you track who's leading[/h1]
In the top right corner, there's a mini-leaderboard showing the top 3 best players by far, the mini-leaderboard updates every 1 minute in real-time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/00e946de5b674e8d0531eb6ceff2392a64908042.png[/img]
If you click on Event's Score, you will see the full leaderboard if a player manages to get at least 1 TOP 3 in any campaign bomb, with their personal best score so you can track which map helping him/her to get the point
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/f1ea1c0163788b43757b9fda98305cb395a0f7e5.png[/img]

What are you waiting for, stop reading and start playing, remember to verify your account so your score can be updated on our server. Hope to see you at the finish line!!!!!

tags.feature: This month's event features the new global leaderboard system

notes.title: It Is Ticking Bug Patch and Event Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Leaderboard Now Shows And Updates Personal Score[/h1]
From now on, your personal score will show up below the scoreboard for you, making it easier to track your personal best without searching for your name in the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/76a8a642d636f3b5652f12e5d6e3572c96a215a9.png[/img]

This score will only show your fastest attempt, your score will be updated if you beat your own personal high score, and yes, we still need you to verify your account for this feature because this will be used in our events with real amazing prizes.

[h1]Youtube Link For Gamers Who Need Help At The Game Available In The Mainmenu[/h1]
It's ok to admit defeat, even developer has a rough time trying to beat the game, and putting the answer on Youtube only may not be the best case, so right now if you look at the game's top-right corner, there's a section to solve every bomb in this game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/9cbf57cb003feee8bc38d633aa2435feae1e995b.png[/img]

If you don't know how components work, you might want to check the bottom-right corner, there will be a "Collection" tab where you can see what they look like and what's the difference between them as well as how they work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/e406af5405a794dbd9b13b2095b8340930e6ff95.png[/img]

[h1]XOR Gate Hot Fix[/h1]
As we all know XOR gate is one of the hardest components for its uniqueness, there are some cases when it turns on will make it turn off, and if it turns off will make it turn on. So we deal with this problem with the "Path-Tracking" solution which will trace the XOR output for its input to prevent a loop, we also fixed a bug reported by "Salad" for unusual self-charging XOR after the patch, huge thanks to him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/7beb4a89ba0b07062c5b4f15182ad581f66420b6.png[/img]

[h2]Workshop easier interaction[/h2]
[list]
[*] Click on the same tab will now close the vertical table.
[*] You can place the same component wherever you like until you left-click or choose something else.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/ac0e107cab2f902e8b93a6dea9f4bf99b4bc6b3d.png[/img]

notes.title: Explosion Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Visual[/h1]
We have upgraded the game's cube map and sharpened the edges of all components, creating a darker visual environment that helps players focus more on the bomb. And if you happen to make a mistake while defusing the bomb, now you can enjoy the spectacle of seeing yourself get blown off in stunning 4K. Experience the new "Cracking Mainboard" effect, which enhances the user experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/e92e415c389cdd304698cddf21c4352be2c53161.png[/img]
[h1]New Components[/h1]
The tried-and-true components have certainly made your life harder than it should be. However, many players have already triumphed over the challenges we created with them. So today, we're introducing four new components that will dramatically increase the level of creativity. Behold:
[list]
[*] The Intersect Gate [Miscellaneous tab] - This component allows players to create complex bomb bases using embedded wires. It serves as a connector when designers attempt to cross two embedded wirelines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/7650c119846c3f609ed8297e8e891a3997418b96.png[/img]
[*] The Persistent Battery [Battery tab] - Acting as a domain battery, this component features two input ports that require players to send electricity to turn the battery on. Once activated, there's no way to turn it off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/740b2adacb4bb31715827470171f8d3962b2e635.png[/img]
[*] Switch Logic Gate [LogicGate tab] - This logic gate requires power input in the "PWR" pin to function fully. With the toggle pin at the bottom, players can decide whether to allow or block the current by sending electricity to the pin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/cf7d81bb8374adfbea46802b4ca8ebaad4dd2e08.png[/img]
[*] NAND Logic Gate [LogicGate tab] - Similar to a battery, this logic gate has two input pins. If both pins receive a signal, the NAND logic gate will stop sending electricity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/3b449d814fbe7b2cff2e95e40c5a8cfcd89b499a.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]New Announcement System[/h1]
With this system, you will never miss any important information from us. It allows you to keep track of ongoing events and new updates, including new components, content, event announcements, prize pools, event winners, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/0f125a0c3bde7cf7b449174c9d5b40d4009abc9b.png[/img]
[h1]Merge Imported Cloud Data and Save Player's Score[/h1]
As mentioned before, the game requires players to be verified before their scores are pushed to the leaderboard. For convenience, we will now save players' scores in our database and push them onto the leaderboard once the player reviews the game. This system enables players to submit their scores without replaying the entire game and protects against fraudulent players trying to exploit our upcoming events. Additionally, we have implemented changes to our saving system to prevent data loss experienced by one player due to the Steam cloud saving system.

[h1]Upcoming Events Roadmap[/h1]
Currently, we don't have enough players to offer high prize pools. Therefore, we will wait for our next milestone to gather more participants. We have plans to reward players with Steam-currency gift cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/ac121aa78e90fdbd85ef535693715262881a1dad.png[/img]
[h3]Possible Challenges[/h3]
We are continuously working on various challenges, including:
[olist]
[*] Accumulate points from the campaign mode leaderboard.
[*] Defuse as many bombs as possible within a 10-minute time limit.
[*] Complete the defusal of a 4-page bomb as quickly as possible.
[*] Engage in multiplayer mode: Connect with a random person, each seeing half of the board, and work together to defuse it.
[*] Defuse as many bombs as possible within a 10-minute time limit, with the mission ending if a bomb explodes.
[*] And more.
[/olist]

[h2]XOR Logic Gate Hotfix[/h2]
Some players have reported potential XOR logic gate bugs via email. In response, we have implemented a checking system that temporarily disables the XOR gate for 0.5 seconds if the bug occurs. This measure addresses visual bugs where users observe electricity passing through the gate without any effect when connected to a buggy XOR gate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/da540dd323fbc11a1c91b2107794fadfdd0b94dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Preparing For Our Next Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Components Kick In[/h1]
We're bringing new components into the game, these electronic devices will be available in the 
in-game workshop editor, and we will make new stages and chapters after there're more components to play around with. So what exactly will be released? 
- "Intersect Gate" [Table Miscellaneous]: This component holds the ability to make 2 embedded wires to cross each other without going all around the bomb design, and you don't want to use normal wire because it would be easy to be cut away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/8064c5f8af336c74851f329ca6510827cf230f44.png[/img]

- "Persistent Energy" [Table Battery]: This will work like a battery with Flip-Flop's logic, once the component gets triggered to the "Activate" state, It'll continuously produce energy like a normal battery, it will stop when there is a trigger to the "Reset" state, This will reduce the amount of wire editor needs to function a FlipFlop gate which guaranteed to has electricity connected to the "PWR" Pin. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/2571cddcd4b0c4ad1d308ad5a751e5d9a7626afa.png[/img]

[h2]These components will be introduced in our next update, along with some of these new life-quality changes below:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Update the number of tries on every bomb.
[*] In-game announces panel.
[*] Workshop Editor "Surging Problems" prevention.
[*] More videos solving every chapter.
[*] More measures to secure the leaderboard system for upcoming events.
[/olist]
[h1]Developer's Comments:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We know about these "Surging Problems" before the game launch, and we did our best not to let them happen in our campaign bombs. However, it seems that players using the editor experienced this issue (although it can be solved easily because it is already wrong with the basic logic), we still gonna make a system to prevent this from happening.
[*] We came along with dozens of component ideas and we decided to put them in one by one in order not to flood new players with complex components. And they will be introduced inside the workshop first, for veteran editors to play with it.
[*] We know who does want to read these kinds of news on Steam library pages? So we will implement the one-time in-game announcement, which will help players to inform the newest information about events, event winners, new components, and changes we made for the game.
[*] We're releasing hints of every chapter on our youtube account, if you struggle with any specific stage, consider taking a shortcut and watch it. 
[*]The channel's link: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCglQ8MUw_sSYWTsly1tb28w]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCglQ8MUw_sSYWTsly1tb28w[/url]
[*] As soon as the playerbase is big enough, we will announce the events for everyone to participate in with tons of prizes, new game modes, and they last for a month each. If you play this game every month, there's no way you can miss it, so there's no need to be rushy, takes your time.
[*] Thanks for your reviews, we hope to see more of your thought about our game, and we're open to any suggestions, ideas, bug reports, etc.
[/list]

And remember, IT IS TICKING.
Yenthe Studio.

notes.title: It Is Ticking Leaderboard and Achievement Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/dd4ee7d8e264a1c20819494b56322a091cdb37f7.png[/img]
[h1]Achievement System Integrated[/h1]
In this update, we bring you a new achievement system that we have been working on for the past few days. With this, players can now see their own progression and others' progression as well. We add 20 achievements that cover almost our current features, which are:
[olist]
[*] Campaign Missions
[*] Workshop Creations
[*] Testing Community maps
[/olist]
There are both easy and hard achievements for players to test themselves on, in order to fully complete the game, players need to experience every aspect the game provided, and in some cases..... they need to spend time to become good designers? Let's see how many players can achieve 100% !!!
Read about those requirements [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2412700/achievements]here[/url]
[h1]Leaderboard System Implemented[/h1]
Are you feeling lonely? You wanna compete with other players? Fear not, because the leaderboard system we put into the game will let you do that with ease. You can now play, retry, play FASTER,...... RETRY FASTER !!!! to see who can defuse faster. The leaderboard is on the right side of every bomb, which helps you see who's taking the lead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/eaeabac76231bf2686c8d6e5bf91583aa300aba1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] All campaign bombs have this feature integrated.
[*] Workshop newly created bombs will automatically implement this feature without any extra steps.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053260/a02d560a360d21abb75c064baa7bb7f29c4656a0.png[/img]
[h2]Developer's Comment[/h2]
There are some note-worthy information players should know:
[list]
[*] For old workshop maps: Go back to Workshop Editor and update the bomb that has already been published to implement the system.
[*] Leaderboard System uses real-time to estimate the speed, using the speed-up button will give you a huge advantage.
[*] [h3]Only players who wrote a review for the game can upload their score on the leaderboard[/h3] (?)
[/list]
(?) Developer's Explanation: 
I'm so sorry for this inconvenience, while developing this feature, we encounter some problems:
[olist]
[*] Player who didn't buy the game can still send a fake score to our database and we have to accept the result.
[*] Mannually deleting suspicious reviews isn't plausible and time-consuming.
[*] We are also going to implement maps statistics such as: 
[list]
[*] Player time.
[*] Total time spent on bombs.
[*] The number of retries.
[*] The number of successful defuses.
[*] The number of current players on the bomb.
[/list]
[*] Steam does not tell us (The Developers) who has the game in the library, we don't know if the score sent to us comes from a legit player or not.
[*] But one thing we're sure about is that if the players can leave a review, there's a high chance that is a legit player, and we can confirm his/her scores.
[*] [h3]We do not care about "Positive" or "Negative" reviews (actually we do care, but our system does not), this is just a method so we can filter most non-legitimate users from entering the scoreboard.[/h3]
[/olist]
